title: The Download: Silicon Valley’s blind spot and Nvidia’s chip-tracking plan
summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Silicon Valley claims to know the future. So why did it get the midterms so wrong? —Aaron Zamost, a tech communications consultant and a former executive at Square The self-styled visionaries…
llm_summary: Silicon Valley prides itself on predicting tech’s next big thing, yet it completely missed the political shift of the recent midterm elections—a misread that highlights a broader blind spot in its cultural and societal awareness. Meanwhile, Nvidia is rolling out a new chip‑tracking system designed to give developers real‑time visibility into GPU usage, aiming to boost performance optimization and streamline supply‑chain logistics.
